'''Berema''' was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Berema patronized the [[Stronghold Cantina|cantina]] in [[Nym's Stronghold]] on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. Berema would often play a simple card game called [[Desert Draw/Legends|Desert Draw]] with other patrons and visitors.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Berema]]
Berema was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Players could play a simple game with her that was played via the dialogue options to win small amounts of credits.
